# GÉANT Wiki

> Central documentation and collaboration hub for GÉANT's federated research and education network infrastructure, services, and community resources.

GÉANT Wiki is built on Atlassian Confluence and serves as the primary knowledge repository for GÉANT's network operations, research initiatives, and collaboration with National Research and Education Networks (NRENs). The wiki supports federated documentation management across multiple organizational spaces and projects.

## Key Topics

- GÉANT
- Confluence
- Federated Infrastructure
- NREN (National Research and Education Networks)
- AAI (Authentication and Authorization Infrastructure)
- eduroam
- Space Directory
- Documentation Portal
- RSS Feed Syndication
- Space Management
- Content Syndication
- Atlassian
- GN4/GN5 Projects
- TNC (TERENA Networking Conference)
- IPv6

## Wiki Navigation & Management

- [Space Directory](https://wiki.geant.org/spacedirectory/view.action): Directory of GÉANT Confluence spaces for federated documentation management
- [RSS Feed Builder](https://wiki.geant.org/configurerssfeed.action): Tool for configuring RSS feeds and content syndication in GÉANT wiki

## Optional

- [About Atlassian Confluence](https://wiki.geant.org/aboutconfluencepage.action): License and attribution information for Atlassian Confluence platform
